title: Fujita 2000 middle AF sheet circumferential shear modulus vs tensile prestrain

quantity.name: equilibrium shear modulus
quantity.definition: in-plane equilibrium shear modulus of a lamellar sheet, shear along the circumferential direction, with tensile prestrain 0/5/10%

source.authors: Fujita Y, Wagner DR, Biviji AA, Duncan NA, Lotz JC
source.sample: 30 AF cube specimens (3.2 mm) + 56/58 lamellar sheet specimens from non-degenerate (grade I-II) lumbar discs of 6 + 6 spines
source.age: cubes: 35, 67, 71 y + 3 unknown; sheets: 36, 71, 82 y + 3 unknown

protocol.summary: Lamellar sheet specimens (3.2 mm wide) from inner, middle, outer AF glued to sandpaper frames; tensile prestrain 0, 5, 10% (axial direction for circumferential shear, circumferential direction for axial shear); preconditioning +-3% shear, then 2.5-10% shear strain steps each held 20 min; equilibrium shear modulus in axial (G31-type, shear along spinal axis in lamellar plane) or circumferential direction.
how_to_simulate: Model a thin AF sheet with in-plane prestrain 0/5/10%
Apply in-plane shear (axial or circumferential direction) stepwise to 10%, relaxed

extraction.check_notes: Table values from text layer (digital publisher PDF), mean +- SD. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
